lede: The biggest decision this week lands Monday in Norwood, where the Planning and Zoning Commission takes up Phase I of a full Land Use Code rewrite — the kind of vote that quietly sets the rules for development and density for years to come. In town, Tuesday's Council meeting has a public hearing on converting two Colorado Avenue affordable units to employee dwelling units by removing the price cap, and the School Board votes the same night on resolutions backing Proposition NN and Amendment 87. The County commissioners also hold a continued public hearing Wednesday on adopting new International Building Codes.

notable.stake: Norwood's Land Use Code rewrite up for formal adoption — shapes future development rules.
